create_map_numerical_mlp: create an MLP that encodes any single-variable numerical function f(x) using discretisation
create_map_numerical_to_categorical_mlp: create an MLP that maps a numerical input to a categorical output via discretisation
create_linear_sequence_map_numerical_mlp: create an MLP that encodes a linear function f(x, y) = a*x + b*y
create_discretising_layer: create a hidden layer that discretises the input of f(x) into a value set
create_discretising_layer_materials: create a dataclass holding action, hidden_space, and output_values for a discretising layer
